causes.title: Quality Primary Education for Slum & Rural Children
causes.shortDescription: Providing school kits, tuition support, and foundational literacy to underprivileged children.
causes.description: Access to early education breaks generational cycles of poverty. This initiative supports learning centers with textbooks, uniforms, after-school tutoring, and digital learning tablets so children can stay in school and thrive.

causes.title: Daily Nutrition & Community Meal Drives
causes.shortDescription: Serving fresh, wholesome hot meals to daily wage laborers, homeless individuals, and children.
causes.description: No one in our community should sleep hungry. Our volunteer kitchens prepare balanced, nutritious meals daily and distribute dry ration emergency kits with rice, lentils, and cooking oil to families facing distress.

causes.title: Free Mobile Health Camps & Diagnostic Care
causes.shortDescription: Delivering basic medical consultations, free medicines, and eye checkups in underserved pockets.
causes.description: Routine healthcare is often inaccessible or prohibitively expensive for rural and informal workers. Our volunteer doctors provide general consultations, diabetes screening, vision tests, and free prescription medications.

causes.title: Livelihood & Tailoring Skills for Women
causes.shortDescription: Empowering women from low-income families with sewing, artisanal crafts, and financial literacy.
causes.description: When a woman earns an independent livelihood, her entire family benefits. This center offers a six-month intensive tailoring course, machine allocation, and micro-business guidance to enable home-based earnings.

causes.title: Clean Drinking Water & Community Sanitation
causes.shortDescription: Installing community bio-sand water filters and clean sanitation facilities in remote hamlets.
causes.description: Waterborne diseases severely impact children in remote villages. We work alongside local residents to construct reliable water purification units and educate schools on hygiene and water conservation.

causes.title: Comfort, Medicine & Shelter for Elderly In Need
causes.shortDescription: Providing medical care, nutritious food, and emotional companionship to destitute seniors.
causes.description: Many elderly citizens live without family support or pension. This initiative provides monthly medicine bundles, mobility aids, regular home check-ins, and assisted living shelter admissions.

events.title: Mega Health & Eye Checkup Camp
events.shortDescription: Comprehensive checkups, blood pressure monitoring, and prescription glasses distribution.
events.description: Open to all community members. Certified volunteer doctors and optometrists will provide free consultations, diabetes screenings, pediatric checks, and basic medication kits.
events.registrationInfo: Walk-ins welcome, or pre-register online to avoid queue waiting.

events.title: Annual Back-to-School Kit Distribution
events.shortDescription: Distributing bags, notebooks, geometry boxes, and stationery to 300 students.
events.description: Join hands as our volunteers pack and distribute essential academic kits for young students before the start of the new academic term.
events.registrationInfo: Volunteers requested to arrive 1 hour early for kit assembly.

events.title: Weekend Nutrition & Food Relief Drive
events.shortDescription: Preparing and serving 500 freshly cooked warm meals and ration distribution.
events.description: Volunteers will assist in packaging food parcels and orderly meal distribution across vulnerable settlements in the district.
events.registrationInfo: Sign up to assist with logistics, cooking, or distribution.

events.title: Tree Plantation & Clean Neighborhood Day
events.shortDescription: Planting 250 native saplings and community clean-up drive.
events.description: Over 60 dedicated local volunteers participated in our neighborhood greening drive planting neem, peepal, and fruit-bearing trees.

testimonials.name: Sunita Sharma
testimonials.message: Volunteering with Seva NGO has been one of the most fulfilling experiences of my life. Seeing children who struggled with basic letters read whole books with confidence makes every weekend worth it.

testimonials.name: Dr. Ramesh K.
testimonials.message: The dedication and transparency of the ground team is exemplary. Healthcare camps are run with dignity, precision, and heartfelt compassion for every patient who walks in.

testimonials.name: Ananya Deshmukh
testimonials.message: I value knowing where every rupee goes. Seva NGO consistently provides transparent updates and real stories of the individuals they support.
